incident-bot: Pager: metering pipeline reported delayed usage window and duplicate tally anomalies for tokens on shard eu-west-2. Severity: P2. First seen 2025-05-02T14:40:34Z
kevin_oncall: ACK. Taking on-call. @alice_sre can you start triage? :mag:
alice_sre: looking into emitter+aggregator traces. seeing late writes from consumer-retry path and delayed batch windows. starting tail on ledger and kafka-retention consumer.
maria_billing: billing checks caught several delayed reports triggering automated overage flags; emails queued at ~14:35-14:38 UTC. Some customers received notices.
jon_prod: which accounts? any enterprise? need CS loop.
sarah_cs: two customers escalated via support portal: nebula-tech and dataforge. CSMs looped. collecting ticket ids.
kevin_oncall: mitigation: 1) pause automated overage notifications 2) set billing pipeline to accept only unique sequence ids for current window 3) enable shadow re-aggregate for affected window 14:00-14:45 UTC. @deploy-bot pause notifications?
deploy-bot: POST /admin/notifications/controls/pause?scope=overage -> OK at 14:42:10 UTC
alice_sre: snippet from emitter logs showing late batch arrival:
```
[14:36:05] emitter: batch_id=bb32a seq_start=48210 seq_end=48299
[14:36:12] retry-producer: batch_id=bb32a seq_start=48210 seq_end=48299 -> resend
[14:36:18] aggregator: ingest seq=48250 ack
```
alice_sre: looks like retry-path duplicated an already-acked batch; aggregator accepted late arrivals leading to double-counting in the shallow window.
maria_billing: running corrective aggregation now. will produce corrected counts and a list of affected customers.
kevin_oncall: quick stopgap: enforce dedupe in aggregator for 30m and increase retention to ensure replays don't double ingest.
alice_sre: applied aggregator patch to check batch_id uniqueness. rolling to canary on eu-west-2-01. watching.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started 14:44:30 UTC -> node eu-west-2-01
alice_sre: canary looks stable after 60s. no duplicate counts observed. scheduling roll to rest of region.
maria_billing: preliminary reconciled sample: `client=nebula-tech reported=5_120 flagged=5_640 corrected=5_128` approx +512 tokens overcount. dataforge similar ~ +1.2k tokens.
sarah_cs: holding customer emails. drafting correction note and prepped refund/credit options. will wait final signoff.
jon_prod: ensure hosted routing uses stable aggregator. temporarily route new writes to primary aggregator only.
kevin_oncall: status: pager->mitigated. notifications paused, dedupe applied, shadow-agg running. follow-ups: run full window reconciliation, issue customer corrections, postmortem assigned to eng-runtime + billing. Reopen if anomalies persist. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Pager closed at 14:48:10 UTC (P2->monitoring). Follow-ups created: tasks/ENG-1121, tasks/BILL-443. Tags: billing, delayed-reports, duplicate-counts.
